_doc: Best-engine-per-type routing standard for diagram primitives. Vetted by the diagram team (knowledge-pack, 22 diagrams / 22 render-clean / 22 PASS / 0 collisions, festidious-diagram-grader, 2026-07-15). THE LAW: D2 encodes a quantity as SIZE (width/height/stroke) — structural, relational, flow, size-encoded families live here, and render IN-PROCESS (pure Go, always browser-free, even at freeze). Mermaid encodes a quantity as POSITION (x/y/radius/angle computed by a layout engine) — the ~5 quantitative/positional/temporal types are genuinely better in Mermaid. A Mermaid diagram freezes to an inline SVG (the frozen artifact reaches out to nothing), but producing that bake requires mmdc/npx present AT FREEZE TIME. An author may always override with an explicit engine; absent that, dtype routes here.

d2.note: pure-Go d2lib, zero external tooling even at freeze time; the always-safe engine

mermaid.note: frozen artifact is inline SVG (browser-free); requires mmdc or npx present at freeze time, else freeze fails loudly (Covenant IV)

flint.note: engine #3 (Slice 0): microsoft/flint-chart draws the quantitative/statistical family (34 types) that neither D2 nor Mermaid does. Author supplies a pre-rendered, freeze-clean Vega-Lite SVG (all 34 knowledge-pack charts MEASURED 0 external refs); std-doc embeds it with ZERO Node/JS bake in the core binary. Live spec->SVG rendering (a Node dependency) is the deferred Slice 1.

class.why: correct UML; use the dark 2-region compartment card to dodge sql_table theme-lock

erd.why: sql_table gives column-anchored FK edges + crow's-foot; add layout-engine:elk for 90 deg routing

c4-architecture.why: containers + local icons (data: URIs, freeze-safe); direction:down to fold the void

state-machine.why: native states + transitions; the built-in statetrack primitive builds this from data

dfd.why: processes/stores/flows; full-bleed dark bg + direction:down for legible aspect

tree.why: hierarchy; the built-in tree primitive builds this from data

block.why: grid layout folds a chain into rows (2448x174 -> 824x492), crops the void

venn.why: set-overlap disposition model; surfaces the center region

mindmap.why: clean vertical tree, zero overlaps — Mermaid's mindmap is dark-on-dark broken; DO NOT route to Mermaid

packet.why: bit-grid via nested-container column spans (same span move as gantt); readable on dark

gantt.why: true continuous time axis; D2 degrades to a day-matrix. Bar width = duration is POSITION, not SIZE

quadrant.why: true 2-D scatter on continuous x/y; widen viewBox so right-edge labels don't clip

journey.why: satisfaction curve (score-as-height) + faces; D2's score boxes are an acceptable fallback

sankey.why: area-conserving proportional ribbons; D2 loses proportionality. Give it vertical height so ribbons separate
